name: Lyo.ContactUs.Postgres
tagline: PostgreSQL and EF Core implementation of `Lyo.ContactUs.IContactUsService` (`PostgresContactUsService`) through `ContactUsDbContext` and `PostgresContactUsOptions`.
description: PostgreSQL and EF Core implementation of [`Lyo.ContactUs.IContactUsService`](../Lyo.ContactUs/README.md) (`PostgresContactUsService`) through `ContactUsDbContext`, `PostgresContactUsOptions`, and `AddPostgresMigrations<ContactUsDbContext, PostgresContactUsOptions>` so the host can apply schema upgrades on startup.

sections.title: Package contents
items: `ContactUsDbContext` + `ContactUsDbContextFactory` under `Database/`, with a single `DbSet<ContactSubmissionEntity>` (name / email / subject / message / phone / company / created timestamp; lengths match `ContactUsRequest`).

`PostgresContactUsService`. A `ContactUsServiceBase` subclass that persists each submission through the registered `IDbContextFactory<ContactUsDbContext>`, logs the new id, and implements `TestConnectionAsync` by issuing `Database.CanConnectAsync(...)`.

sections.title: Service registration (`Extensions`)
rows: Registers the DbContext factory plus a scoped `ContactUsDbContext` resolved from the factory. Useful for ad-hoc EF code.

Registers `IOptions<PostgresContactUsOptions>`, `AddPostgresMigrations<ContactUsDbContext, PostgresContactUsOptions>()`, and `IDbContextFactory<ContactUsDbContext>` (`UseNpgsql` + migrations history under the `contact` schema).
Calls `AddContactUsDbContextFactory(...)`, ensures a `ContactUsServiceOptions` singleton exists (defaults if not provided), and registers `IContactUsService` → scoped `PostgresContactUsService`.
sections.trail: `AddContactUsPostgres(...)` is the usual one-shot registration. Use `AddContactUsDbContextFactory(...)` plus your own service registration when you want to wrap or decorate the service yourself.

sections.title: Database schema
sections.trail: Migrations history is tracked in `__EFMigrationsHistory` under the `contact` schema configured on `PostgresContactUsOptions.Schema`.
